aj4903.bio: Named in the dataset's chains and matched to entries in the scholars' biographical books. No Taqrīb profile has been matched yet; the verdicts below are quoted from the books cited.
s: Name as indexed in a chain
as: Abū Zurʿah al-Rāzī, quoted by al-Mizzī
He was trustworthy, a jurist, with many hadith.
Mālik ibn Anas, quoted by al-Mizzī
كان عندنا رجال من أهل العلم اسم أحدهم كنيته، منهم أبو سلمة بن عبد الرحمن
We had men of learning whose name was their kunya, among them Abū Salamah.
أربعة من قريش وجدتهم بحورا": سعيد بن المسيب، وعروة بن الزبير، وأبو سلمة بن عبد الرحمن
Four of Quraysh I found to be oceans of knowledge: Saʿīd ibn al-Musayyib, ʿUrwah ibn al-Zubayr, Abū Salamah...
وكان أبو سلمة كثيرا" مما يخالف ابن عباس، فحرم لذلك من ابن عباس علما" كثيرا
Abū Salamah often disagreed with Ibn ʿAbbās, and so was deprived of much knowledge from him.
إبراهيم بن عبد الله بن قارظ, quoted by al-Mizzī
لقد تركت رجلين من قومك لا أعلم أكثر حديثا" منهما: عروة بن الزبير، وأبو سلمة بن عبد الرحمن
You have left two men of your people than whom I know none with more hadith: ʿUrwah and Abū Salamah.
He was reliable, a jurist, and a prolific transmitter.
Saʿīd ibn al-Musayyib, quoted by Ibn Saʿd
إنه وهو صغير أفقه منه كبيرا
After Abū Salamah bought a sand-grouse at al-ʿArj while in iḥrām and Saʿīd slaughtered it, Saʿīd said: he had more understanding as a youngster than he has grown up.

t2159.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Zayd ibn Wahb al-Juhanī, Abū Sulaymān al-Kūfī, as a mukhaḍram, trustworthy and eminent; whoever claimed a defect in his hadith erred. He died after eighty, or it is said in 96.
as: لم يصب من قال في حديثه خلل
Whoever said there is a defect in his hadith did not hit the mark.
إذا حدثك زيد بن وهب عن أحد، فكأنك سمعته من الذي حدثك عنه.
When Zayd ibn Wahb relates something to you from someone, it is as if you heard it from that person himself.
Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, quoted by al-Mizzī
كوفي، ثقة، دخل الشام، وروايته عن أبي ذر صحيحة.
A reliable Kufan who entered Syria. His transmission from Abū Dharr is sound.
They agreed in declaring him reliable.
يعقوب بن سفيان, quoted by Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī
أشار إلى أنه كبر وتغير ضبطه
Yaʿqūb ibn Sufyān indicated that he grew old and his accuracy changed.
ابن حزم, quoted by Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī
زيد بن وهب صاحب من الصحابة
Ibn Ḥazm regarded Zayd as a Companion.
He was reliable and transmitted many hadiths.

t3794.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abzā al-Khuzāʿī as a young Companion who was a man in ʿUmar's time and served as governor of Khurāsān for ʿAlī.
as: نافع بن عبد الحارث, quoted by al-Mizzī
إنه قارئ لكتاب الله، عالم بالفرائض.
He recites God's Book and knows the laws of inheritance.
ذكره ابن حبان في التابعين من كتاب "الثقات" .
Ibn Ḥibbān listed him among the trustworthy Successors.
Ibn Ḥibbān, quoted by Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī
وذكره ابن حبان في ثقات التابعين.
Ibn Ḥibbān listed him among the trustworthy Successors.
لنافع بن عبد الحارث الخزاعي, quoted by Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī
إنه قارئ لكتاب الله، عالم بالفرائض.
He recites God's Book and knows the laws of inheritance.
لنافع بن عبد الحارث الخزاعي, quoted by Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī
And the most knowledgeable among them about God's religion.
ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb, quoted by Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr
عبد الرحمن بن أبزى ممن رفعه الله بالقرآن.
ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abzā is among those whom God raised through the Quran.
ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb, quoted by Ibn al-Athīr
عبد الرحمن بن أبزي ممن رفعه الله بالقرآن.
ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abzā was among those whom God raised through the Quran.
نافع بن عبد الحارث, quoted by Ibn al-Athīr
إني وجدته أقرأهم لكتاب الله وأفقههم في دين الله.
I found him the most proficient of them in reciting God's Book and the most learned about God's religion.

t4041.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Yazīd ibn Jābir al-Azdī, Abū ʿUtba al-Shāmī al-Dārānī, as trustworthy, of the seventh generation, who died in the fifties.
as: There is nothing wrong with him.
Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, quoted by al-Mizzī
يعقوب بن سفيان, quoted by al-Mizzī
عبد الرحمن ويزيد ابنا يزيد بن جابر ثقتان
ʿAbd al-Raḥmān and Yazīd, the sons of Yazīd ibn Jābir, are both trustworthy.

أبو بكر بن أبو داود, quoted by al-Mizzī
موسى بن هارون, quoted by al-Mizzī
وابن جابر ثقة، وابن تميم ضعيف
Ibn Jābir is trustworthy, while Ibn Tamīm is weak.
وكذلك قال أحمد بن عبد الله العجلي
Ibn Saʿd likewise called him trustworthy.
Al-Nasāʾī and others likewise called him trustworthy.
ʿAlī ibn al-Madīnī, quoted by al-Mizzī
يعد في الطبقة الثانية من فقهاء أهل الشام بعد الصحابة
He is counted in the second class of the jurists of Syria after the Companions.
